maddeler.e:
تقتصدوا (form VIII)
# تَقْتَصِدُوا (taqtaṣidū) /taq.ta.sˤi.duː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِقْتَصَدَ (iqtaṣada)
# تُقْتَصَدُوا (tuqtaṣadū) /tuq.ta.sˤa.duː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِقْتَصَدَ (iqtaṣada)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
